findings.problem: Immediate try_recv after socket EOF can race the destruction sender on another runtime worker.
findings.remedy: Await the destruction receiver under its finite observation timeout before baseline cleanup.

disposition: Regression source accepted after separately reviewed notification correction; no runtime claim.
limitations: No Cargo, tests, network or compiler checks executed by reviewer.
Owner wrappers intentionally preserve baseline detach behavior; fallback cleanup demonstrates bounded controlled teardown, not safe baseline cancellation on every exceptional path.
Pinned task is_finished observes completion only; it does not observe JoinError or prove a cancellation classification.
Two- and ten-second bounds are observation limits, not permanent leak proof.
Additional supporting files read only in the stated ranges.
The original raw refusal task remains source scope for a subsequent complete remedy, not an extra control in this checkpoint.
